newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Commerce Commission clears NZ Post's parcel buy.
newsitem.headline: NZ Commerce Commission clears NZ Post's parcel buy.

text.p: New Zealand's competition regulator, the Commerce Commission, said on Monday it had cleared state-owned New Zealand Post Ltd's plan to acquire the Express Freight Services businesses of privately-owned Freightways Ltd, subject to NZ Post divesting some assets.

"The proposed acquisition would result in NZ Post being the largest provider of parcel delivery services across the range of local and national parcel delivery markets," the commission said in a statement.
However, it was satisfied that strong competition would remain and that existing and new competitiors would be able to expand their share if the opportunity arose.

The terms of the proposed deal have not been revealed but the acquisition covers a number of local and regional companies which are active in same-day, overnight and national line haul market as well as regional air freight.
